map.压强不变时，理想气体体积与热力学温度成正比。: At constant pressure, ideal-gas volume is proportional to thermodynamic temperature.
map.V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂，温度须为开尔文。: V1/T1 = V2/T2; temperature must be in kelvin.
map.定压下理想气体体积与绝对温度成正比。: At constant pressure, ideal-gas volume is proportional to absolute temperature.
map.热气球、气体体积随温变估算。: Estimate hot-air balloons and gas volume change with temperature.
map.T2=223 K：V2=0.816 L，体积随绝对温度线性减小。: T2=223 K: V2=0.816 L; volume decreases linearly with absolute temperature.
map.比例只对绝对温度成立，摄氏零度仍有体积。: The proportion holds only for absolute temperature; at zero Celsius the gas still has volume.
map.需压强恒定，否则需联合玻意耳定律。: Pressure must be constant; otherwise combine with Boyle law.
map.查理定律（等压过程）：末态体积 V₂ = V₁ × T₂ ÷ T₁（温度须为开尔: Charles's law (isobaric process): final volume V₂ = V₁ × T₂ ÷ T₁ (temperatures must be in kelvin K); linked cards: volume magnification = T₂ ÷ T₁, volume change ΔV = V₂ − V₁. Validation: non-empty valid-numeric guards for V₁, T₁ and T₂. Criteria: at constant pressure volume is proportional to thermodynamic temperature, so T₂ > T₁ expands and T₂ < T₁ contracts.
